visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Binary Search Instead of a Full Scan
visualizerParams.problemDescription: A loop looks at every element of a sorted array. Replace it with a binary search that halves the range each time. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Because the array is sorted, each comparison discards half of the remaining candidates. For a million elements that is about 20 comparisons instead of a million.
